results.title: ‘Exceptionally severe’ oil well eruption in Niger raises fears for threatened desert wildlife
results.snippet:
The Goumeri W8, W3 and W4 wells are part of the Agadem oil block, operated primarily by CNPC Niger Petroleum SA, a local subsidiary of state-owned Chinese oil company China National Petroleum Corporation.

Agadem is located in the south of the country, close to the border with Chad and Nigeria. [...] Banner image: Gas flaring at an oil installation of the China National Petroleum Corporation Niger
